title: Advanced capability and trust bundle wire
description: Generated by advancedcapabilitygen/v1 from contract.json. Documents are exact RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes; the capability signature is Ed25519 over SHA-256(schemaVersion || 0x00 || unsigned JCS).

Capability.description: Capability is one stackkit.advanced-capability/v1 document. Its canonical bytes are RFC 8785 (JCS): members in code-point order, no whitespace, and every value validated ASCII.

allowedOperations.description: AllowedOperations is the sorted, duplicate-free operation set.

applicationRelease.description: ApplicationRelease binds a short-lived scoped release update to one catalog use case and the exact release, manifest digest and tested or untested kind the Owner approved in Techstack.

backupRenewal.description: BackupRenewal is present only on a single short-lived restore.drill capability.

issuerId.description: IssuerID names a Techstack issuer (see IssuerClass).

keyId.description: KeyID is ed25519://sha256/<hex SHA-256 of the raw public key>.

ownApplicationLifecycle.description: OwnApplicationLifecycle binds a short-lived own-application.lifecycle capability to one application, one action, one operation ID and the review digest of its dry run.

signature.description: Signature is the unpadded standard-Base64 Ed25519 signature over SigningDigest of the unsigned canonical bytes.

transferReceive.description: TransferReceive binds a short-lived receiving step to the exact receiving desired intent and the one source Owner Techstack admitted for this move.

transferRetirement.description: TransferRetirement binds a short-lived retirement to the exact existing held snapshot, signed peer outcome and canonical desired-intent transition.

ApplicationRelease.description: ApplicationRelease authorizes one scoped release update of the single application a catalog use case selects on a managed node: the node stops it, retains and reads back its data, records the release override in its desired intent and runs generate, apply and verify, rolling back to the prior release and data on failure. It grants no other intent change, no StackKits release change, no data deletion, server or provider authority. The consumer reconstructs every field from its own command and catalog.

BackupRenewal.description: BackupRenewal authorizes one local staged drill against unchanged applied authority after fresh managed entitlement, usage and remote target attestation. It grants no remote snapshot or data activation authority.

OwnApplicationLifecycle.description: OwnApplicationLifecycle authorizes exactly one reviewed action (start, stop, restart, update, rollback or discard-checkpoint) of one own application on a managed node: the operation ID and the review digest its dry run returned. It grants no create, remove, data deletion, server or provider authority. The consumer compares every field with the call it admits.

TransferReceive.description: TransferReceive authorizes one receiving step of a native application transfer on an Advanced destination: admit (issue the destination admission for the staged receiving candidate), prepare (adopt the transferred credentials before the first Apply) or import (activate the transferred data). It names the exact receiving desired intent and the source Owner; it grants no source, retirement, deletion, server or provider authority. The consumer reconstructs every field from its own workspace and the authenticated transfer.

TransferRetirement.description: TransferRetirement authorizes only selected intent retirement within its original held snapshot after the signed peer outcome is verified. It grants no runtime activation, source restart, data deletion, server or provider authority. The consumer must reconstruct and compare every field from its authenticated journal and canonical candidate.

TrustBundle.description: TrustBundle is one stackkit.advanced-trust-bundle/v1 document. It holds public verification keys only; the Owner imports it pinned by Digest.

TrustBundleKey.description: TrustBundleKey binds one Techstack issuer to one raw Ed25519 public key.

publicKey.description: PublicKey is the unpadded standard-Base64 raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.
